status.description: The consumer-side lifecycle status of the Share Subscription. Additional ShareSubscriptionStatus types may be added over time.

values.description: The subscription is bound to the producer offer, but its shared content is not yet provisioned.
The shared content is provisioned and accessible.
The invitation or share is no longer valid.

producerTenantDetails.description: The identity details of the producer tenant offering the shared content. This property is returned only when getting a Share Subscription and is excluded when listing Share Subscriptions.

shareVersion.description: The zero-padded producer content version that the subscription last synchronized. The value is null until the first synchronization.

ProducerTenantDetails.description: Contains the identity details of the producer tenant.

verifiedDomainName.description: The producer tenant verified domain name.

ShareSubscriptions.description: Contains a list of Share Subscriptions.

CreateShareSubscriptionRequest.description: Contains the request payload for creating a Share Subscription.

description.description: The Share Subscription description. Maximum length is 256 characters.

folderId.description: The folder ID. If not specified or null, the Share Subscription is created with the workspace as its folder.

sensitivityLabelSettings.description: The sensitivity label settings for the Share Subscription.

creationPayload.description: The payload that binds the Share Subscription to a producer invitation.

ShareSubscriptionCreationPayload.description: Contains the creation payload for a Share Subscription.

invitationUrl.description: The IQShare invitation URL used to bind the Share Subscription to the producer offer.

UpdateShareSubscriptionRequest.description: Contains the request payload for updating a Share Subscription.

description.description: The Share Subscription description. Maximum length is 256 characters.
